strings.zh: 我听到了！{NEWLINE}这里是露天的,{CLEAR}信号特别好！
strings.en: Yep, I can really hear you!{NEWLINE}This area is open to the sky, so you can{CLEAR}get a great signal here!

strings.zh: 我要永远和{VAR:0100:10}在一起！{CLEAR}因为它实在太可爱了。{SCROLL}对了,前段时间我遇到了{VAR:0100:11},{CLEAR}还以为它会很强的,{CLEAR}结果我很轻松就赢了！{SCROLL}下次再聊吧！
strings.en: I’m going to stay with my {VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}forever! It’s just too cute.{SCROLL}Oh yeah, the other day I ran into{NEWLINE}a {VAR:0100:11}. I thought it’d be{CLEAR}strong, but I beat it easily!{SCROLL}Let’s talk again, huh?

strings.zh: 我要永远和{VAR:0100:10}在一起！{CLEAR}因为它实在太可爱了。{SCROLL}对了,你有{VAR:0100:11}吗？{SCROLL}感觉它根本抓不到啊,{NEWLINE}它到底有什么弱点呢？{SCROLL}下次再聊吧！
strings.en: I’m always with my {VAR:0100:10}!{NEWLINE}It’s so cute! I just love it!{SCROLL}I was wondering, do you happen to{NEWLINE}have {VAR:0100:11}?{SCROLL}I can’t seem to catch one. What is{NEWLINE}its weakness, I wonder.{SCROLL}Let’s talk again, huh?

strings.zh: 我们来一场精灵对战吧！{SCROLL}我就在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}到了就支应一声！{SCROLL}在手机地图上点击一下{VAR:0104:3}{CLEAR}就会出现！的标志。{CLEAR}所以你不必担心忘记地点！
strings.en: Hey, let’s battle our Pokémon!{SCROLL}I’m on {VAR:0104:3}, so let me{NEWLINE}know when you get here!{SCROLL}If you check the Town Map on{NEWLINE}your Pokégear, you can touch{CLEAR}{VAR:0104:3} and a “!”{CLEAR}will appear so you won’t forget{CLEAR}the location!

strings.zh: 快点来对战啊！{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！{SCROLL}要是你忘记位置了,{NEWLINE}可以在手机地图上{CLEAR}好好确认一下！
strings.en: Let’s battle. I’ll be waiting for you on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}!{SCROLL}If you don’t know where I am, just{NEWLINE}check it on the Town Map on{CLEAR}your Pokégear!

strings.zh: 虽说我能为了虫精灵{NEWLINE}甘愿赴汤蹈火！{SCROLL}但我还是会一直留在{NEWLINE}３５号道路的。{SCROLL}在这附近有池塘有草丛,{CLEAR}而且到自然公园{CLEAR}只要走２８步就到了。{CLEAR}我最喜欢这里了。
strings.en: If it’s for Bug-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon, I’ll go anywhere!{SCROLL}Well, I say that, but{NEWLINE}I’m always on Route 35.{SCROLL}But there’s a pond near here, and{NEWLINE}there’s a lot of grass, and best of{CLEAR}all, it’s only 28 steps to the National{CLEAR}Park. This is such a great spot!
